items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: And it was Jon Faddis, Alex Foster, Bill Evans the tenor player, myself on the trombone, Danny Gottlieb, Mark Egan and Gil Goldstein. That was the band.

ctx.x: Yeah. His chord symbols were very exacting in his charts. And I wrote an album, shortly after Gil died I wrote an album called — a small group album with four horns, “Standards of Living” is the name of it. And it was those voicings. I wanted to keep part

of Gil alive so I wrote a whole bunch of jazz standards with the Gil Evans voicings in them. And it was Jon Faddis, Alex Foster, Bill Evans the tenor player, myself on the trombone, Danny Gottlieb, Mark Egan and Gil Goldstein. That was the band.
It’s like you’ve cloned yourself to be in so many places seemingly in the same time.
